body:
# Just QoL (Server)!

This is an efficient and lightweight server modpack for any group of friends who simply want to enjoy vanilla Minecraft without too much going on, but cannot live without QoL essentials. This server modpack does all the server-side setup for you and includes optimization mods so that any old, server-repurposed laptop or potato server host can run it. This is the perfect solution for people who think Paper/Bukkit strays too far from vanilla and simply want a pure Fabric server instead. 

A few client-side mods are recommended, but these are completely optional and not required to join the server.

## Main Contenders
- Lithium/FerriteCore
- Krypton
- TT20
- Spark
- C2ME
- Clumps
- Alternate Current
- ServerCore
- Jade
- Carpet
- And more!
